name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a US-based natural resource company focused exclusively on the state of Nevada, holding a large strategic land position and royalties across multiple high-grade historical mining districts. The company operates as an explorer and royalty generator, with a $5M exploration earn-in agreement for a 50% interest in the Lapon Canyon Project and a 3% Net Smelter Royalty on that project. It is in the early exploration stage.
